officialHeightDatumAssessment.conclusion: ETA 4.50 mm is an official height anchor, but its datum surfaces cannot be mapped to the rendered Box3 extrema from the currently available primary source. The difference is descriptive only and is not an adjustment amount.

measurementBasis.comparisonQualification: ETA 4.50 mm and the app 6.645 model-unit Y envelope do not share verified datum surfaces. The 2.145 mm difference is descriptive only and is not a Phase 2 adjustment amount.

facts.target: current app movement Y envelope (datum basis not aligned to ETA height)
facts.recommendation: The 2.145 mm descriptive difference is not an adjustment amount. Measure three separate Phase 2 envelopes and align datum surfaces before deciding whether any thickness adjustment is warranted.

Review together with dial and hand reach.

Preserve coupling and revise only after dial hierarchy is fixed.
